description: Single source of truth for the SimCore device configuration contract. Firmware structures, parser key allow-lists, configurator types and validation, and the public property documentation are generated from this file. Run tools/generate_configuration_schema.py after editing.

kMaximumPayloadSize.doc: Maximum compact JSON payload in bytes, for both the wire and NVS.

kMaximumScreens.doc: Dashboard screens. Raising this multiplies per-screen widget storage and requires an explicit RAM-budget review.

kMaximumWidgetsPerScreen.doc: Ordered widget references per screen. Bounds the sum of every widget variant on one screen.

kMaximumDeltaTimeWidgets.doc: Delta Time widget storage per screen.

kWidgetIdCapacity.doc: Widget identifier storage including the terminator (15 usable bytes).

kWidgetTitleCapacity.doc: Widget title text storage including the terminator (15 usable bytes).

kUnavailableTextCapacity.doc: Placeholder text storage including the terminator (15 usable bytes).

kDeltaTimeTextCapacity.doc: Delta Time placeholder storage including the terminator (15 usable bytes).

kValidationPathCapacity.doc: Storage for the dotted property path reported with a rejection, including the terminator.

kValueBindingCapacity.doc: Canonical telemetry field name storage including the terminator (39 usable bytes). Must match CANONICAL_NAME_CAPACITY in tools/generate_telemetry_catalog.py.

kTransparentColor.doc: Sentinel meaning no background is painted. Not representable in JSON; omit the property instead.

FontSpec.doc: Uploaded font asset reference. Resolution is exact; a missing family/size is a composition error.

TimeTransformConfig.doc: Stateless time formatting configuration owned by utils/transformers/time_transform.

BoardId.doc: Immutable hardware identity. Must match the firmware build or the configuration is rejected.

TelemetryTransportId.doc: Telemetry transport selection. board_default defers to the immutable board descriptor.

DeltaTimeUnavailableBehavior.doc: What the Delta Time widget shows while its telemetry is unavailable.

TextAlignment.doc: Horizontal alignment of a text widget value.

ValueTransformType.doc: Presentation transform applied after the modifier pipeline.

ValueModifierType.doc: Stateful value processing implemented by a module behind the pipeline callback.

WidgetType.doc: Widget kind discriminator. Selects the compile-time widget descriptor used to build the widget.

HardwareConfiguration.doc: Reserved bounded peripheral section. No user-configurable peripheral driver has a complete production contract yet, so a non-empty list is rejected rather than guessed.

DeltaTimeConfiguration.doc: Delta Time module configuration. Distinct from the Delta Time widget, which owns presentation only.

WidgetPlacement.doc: Absolute geometry in logical screen pixels.

ValueTransform.doc: Stateless presentation transform. Absent means no transform is applied.

DeltaTimeWidgetConfiguration.doc: Renders Delta Time module state. Requires the delta_time module section to be present.

TextWidgetConfiguration.doc: Reusable telemetry text widget. Consumes one canonical binding through a pre-bound typed callback.

WidgetReference.doc: Declaration-order reference into the typed widget storage of one screen. Carries the ordering keys so compositing needs no widget-type knowledge: z_index ascending, authored array order breaking ties.

ScreenConfiguration.doc: One dashboard screen. A screen is the coordinate space for the widgets it owns.

fields.name: widgets
fields.doc: Heterogeneous widget array discriminated by the type property. Each element is parsed into the typed storage for its variant.

validation_errors.name: malformed
validation_errors.doc: Not parseable JSON, oversized payload, or trailing content.

validation_errors.name: unsupported_schema
validation_errors.doc: Stored record uses a schema version this firmware does not accept.

validation_errors.name: board_mismatch
validation_errors.doc: Board identifier does not match the firmware build.

validation_errors.name: invalid_hardware
validation_errors.doc: Hardware list is not an empty array.

validation_errors.name: invalid_transport
validation_errors.doc: Unknown transport or one the board does not support.

validation_errors.name: invalid_uart
validation_errors.doc: UART pins do not match the board or baud rate is out of range.

validation_errors.name: invalid_module
validation_errors.doc: Module section value out of range.

validation_errors.name: invalid_screen
validation_errors.doc: Screen section is malformed or the screen count is out of range.

validation_errors.name: invalid_dashboard
validation_errors.doc: Dashboard section is malformed or references an absent module.

validation_errors.name: invalid_widget
validation_errors.doc: Widget property is malformed, out of range, or outside the screen bounds.

validation_errors.name: unknown_property
validation_errors.doc: Property name is not part of this schema version.

validation_errors.name: duplicate_property
validation_errors.doc: Property appears more than once in the same object.
